design_system_archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST + ARCHETYPE 2: THE PERFORMANCE PRO (Tactical Security Command Console)

theme_strategy.rationale: SOC analysts operate on 8 to 12-hour monitoring shifts. Deep graphite surfaces (#0A0C0E / #121518) reduce eye fatigue, heighten optical recognition of high-severity alerts (Signal Red, Warning Amber), and create a high-contrast backdrop for honest epistemic states (Cyan/Slate). Light mode is preserved as a high-density analytical printing/export mode.

evidence_present.label: EVIDENCE PRESENT
evidence_present.design_note: Solid emerald indicator with verified timestamp and hash link. Communicates confirmed, immutable telemetry.

no_evidence.label: NO EVIDENCE
no_evidence.design_note: Crisp slate outline badge with slash pattern. Explicitly communicates telemetry ran and found zero matches (honest negative).

unknown.label: UNKNOWN / UNEVALUATED
unknown.design_note: Tactical amber dashed pill. Indicates query capable but state pending execution or unasserted.

not_run.label: NOT_RUN
not_run.design_note: Subtle violet chip with double border. Explicitly signifies playbook or rule engine skip condition.

capability_unavailable.label: CAPABILITY UNAVAILABLE
capability_unavailable.design_note: Hatched crimson container. Used when endpoint collector is offline or transport never connected.

scale.h1_hero: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-none
scale.h4_widget: text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-400

elevation.card_hover: border border-slate-700/80 bg-[#16191D] shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)] -translate-y-[1px] transition-all duration-150

disabled_items_handling.strategy: Show all 7 legitimately unavailable/unwired features inline with a crisp 'NOT_RUN' or 'UNWIRED' badge and explicit opacity (50%), with a tooltip explaining required collector or licence key.
disabled_items_handling.reasoning: Hiding disabled features creates confusion; greying them out without explanation looks broken. Honest tagging reinforces the Honest State philosophy.

kpi_strips.provenance_badge: Every KPI tile carries a live indicator pill: `[LIVE · count_source: real_time]` with last-heartbeat latency.
kpi_strips.layout: 8-tile horizontal grid with 1px slate divider and severity accent left border.

triage_table.hover_state: Row highlighting with left severity border shift and inline quick-action drawer trigger.

side_drawer.type: Sliding progressive disclosure pane (480px width) for evidence chain, raw payload, and provenance trail without page navigation context loss.

evidence_traceability.pattern: Hover or click on any metric, IOC or hash opens an inline Epistemic Inspector pill showing Raw Ingestion Event ID, Collector Name, Timestamp (UTC), and cryptographic SHA-256 telemetry fingerprint.

edges.confirmed: Solid 2px emerald line with directional pulse animation

phased_rollout_plan.title: Investigation Workspace & Attack Graph Visual Upgrade
phased_rollout_plan.scope: Enhance entity-relationship node visualizers and 8-tab analyst workspace with strict dark surfaces and high-contrast telemetry panels.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly enforce the 'Honest State' paradigm: never fabricate or interpolate empty data. Use explicit epistemic badges (`EVIDENCE PRESENT`, `NO EVIDENCE`, `UNKNOWN`, `NOT_RUN`, `CAPABILITY UNAVAILABLE`) styled with high authority. Apply dark mode (#0A0C0E background, #121518 surface) with crisp 1px borders (#1F242B) and Chivo + JetBrains Mono fonts. Ensure all interactive components include kebab-case data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Never use dark gradients; use solid dark structural tones with sharp 1px borders.
Do NOT use Space Grotesk font or #1B93A4 / #7351B7 forbidden colors.
Always specify data-testid attributes on buttons, links, search inputs, badges, and row items.
Never use AI assistant emojis as UI icons; use lucide-react icons exclusively.
Always display live provenance indicators on counts and telemetry metrics.
